changes: Each hit's note events wait in stock's UI queue until the UI task takes them. 0.2.1 dropped a hit whenever more than 30 messages waited there, stock's included, which BD ANALOG load and pad pressure pass during a retrig hold. A slot is now freed once the UI task has taken its message and another (read from the queue's read index and count), so only the module's own waiting events count; 128 slots, about 3.6 KB more RAM. Recording, the grid and the RTRG key are unchanged.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
